column1: blouse|n.|女用襯衫|She wore a white blouse with a black skirt.|她穿著白色襯衫配黑色裙子。|This silk blouse needs to be washed by hand.|這件絲質襯衫需要手洗。
pants|n.|長褲|These pants are a little too long for me.|這條褲子對我來說有點太長了。|He spilled coffee on his pants.|他把咖啡灑在褲子上了。
jeans|n.|牛仔褲|I usually wear jeans and a T-shirt on weekends.|我週末通常穿牛仔褲和 T 恤。|She bought a new pair of jeans yesterday.|她昨天買了一條新牛仔褲。
trousers|n.|長褲（英式）|He ironed his trousers before the interview.|他在面試前把長褲燙平。|These trousers are too tight around the waist.|這條長褲腰圍太緊了。
shorts|n.|短褲|It's so hot today that I'm wearing shorts.|今天太熱了，所以我穿短褲。|He changed into shorts to go running.|他換上短褲去跑步。
pajamas|n.|睡衣|The children put on their pajamas and went to bed.|孩子們穿上睡衣就去睡覺了。|I stayed in my pajamas all morning.|我整個早上都穿著睡衣待在家。
underwear|n.|內衣褲|Don't forget to pack extra underwear for the trip.|別忘了為旅行多帶幾件內衣褲。|She folded the clean underwear and put it in the drawer.|她把乾淨的內衣褲摺好放進抽屜。
sock|n.|襪子|I can't find my other sock.|我找不到另一隻襪子。|He wore a different colored sock on each foot.|他兩隻腳穿了不同顏色的襪子。
sandal|n.|涼鞋|She left her sandal on the beach.|她把一隻涼鞋留在海灘上了。|These sandals are comfortable in summer.|這雙涼鞋夏天穿很舒服。
sneaker|n.|運動鞋，球鞋|I need a new pair of sneakers for gym class.|我需要一雙新的運動鞋上體育課。|His white sneakers got dirty in the rain.|他的白色球鞋在雨中弄髒了。
slipper|n.|拖鞋|Please take off your shoes and wear these slippers.|請脫鞋並穿上這雙拖鞋。|My dog likes to chew on my slippers.|我的狗喜歡咬我的拖鞋。
hoodie|n.|連帽上衣|He pulled up the hood of his hoodie because of the rain.|因為下雨，他把連帽上衣的帽子戴了起來。|I always wear a hoodie when it's chilly.|天氣有點涼的時候，我總是穿連帽上衣。
zipper|n.|拉鏈|The zipper on my jacket is stuck.|我外套的拉鏈卡住了。|Could you help me with the zipper on my dress?|可以幫我拉一下洋裝的拉鏈嗎？
silk|n.|絲，絲綢|The scarf is made of pure silk.|這條圍巾是純絲做的。|Silk feels very soft against the skin.|絲綢貼著皮膚感覺非常柔軟。
paperclip|n.|迴紋針|Use a paperclip to hold the pages together.|用迴紋針把這幾頁夾在一起。|There's a paperclip at the bottom of my bag.|我的包包底部有一個迴紋針。
binder|n.|資料夾，活頁夾|She keeps all her notes in a blue binder.|她把所有筆記放在一個藍色的活頁夾裡。|Please put the handouts in your binder.|請把講義放進你的資料夾。
scanner|n.|掃描機，掃描器|Put the document on the scanner and press the green button.|把文件放在掃描機上，然後按綠色按鈕。|The scanner is next to the printer.|掃描機就在印表機旁邊。
pencil|n.|鉛筆|Please fill in the form with a pencil.|請用鉛筆填寫這份表格。|I need to sharpen my pencil.|我需要削鉛筆。
eraser|n.|橡皮擦|Use an eraser to remove the mistake.|用橡皮擦把錯誤擦掉。|My pencil has an eraser on the end.|我的鉛筆尾端有一塊橡皮擦。
highlighter|n.|螢光筆|She marked the key points with a yellow highlighter.|她用黃色螢光筆標出重點。|Do you have a highlighter I can borrow?|你有螢光筆可以借我嗎？
notebook|n.|筆記本|I wrote down his phone number in my notebook.|我把他的電話號碼寫在筆記本裡。|Please open your notebook to page ten.|請把你的筆記本翻到第十頁。
notepad|n.|便條紙，記事本|She jotted the address on a notepad.|她把地址草草記在便條紙上。|There is a notepad next to the phone.|電話旁邊有一本便條紙。
cubicle|n.|辦公隔間|His cubicle is next to the window.|他的辦公隔間在窗戶旁邊。|She decorated her cubicle with family photos.|她用家人的照片裝飾自己的辦公隔間。
headset|n.|耳機麥克風，頭戴式耳機|The operator wore a headset to answer calls.|接線員戴著耳機麥克風接聽電話。|I use a headset when I join online meetings.|我參加線上會議時會戴耳機麥克風。
glue|n.|膠水|Put some glue on the back of the paper.|在紙的背面塗上一些膠水。|The glue hasn't dried yet.|膠水還沒乾。
clipboard|n.|寫字板，板夾|The nurse wrote the information on a clipboard.|護理師把資料寫在寫字板上。|He held a clipboard and asked people questions.|他拿著板夾向人們提問。
boarding|n.|登機，登車|Boarding begins at gate 12 in twenty minutes.|二十分鐘後在 12 號登機門開始登機。|Please have your boarding pass ready.|請準備好您的登機證。
customs|n.|海關|We had to go through customs after landing.|降落後我們必須通過海關。|The officer at customs checked my bag.|海關人員檢查了我的包包。
takeoff|n.|起飛|Please turn off your phone before takeoff.|起飛前請關閉您的手機。|The takeoff was delayed because of the storm.|因為暴風雨，起飛時間延後了。
landing|n.|降落，著陸|The plane made a smooth landing.|飛機平穩地降落。|Please stay seated until the landing is complete.|降落完成前請留在座位上。
sightseeing|n.|觀光，遊覽|We spent the day sightseeing in Kyoto.|我們在京都觀光了一整天。|The bus tour is a good way to go sightseeing.|搭巴士旅遊是觀光的好方法。
bellhop|n.|旅館行李員|The bellhop carried our bags to the room.|行李員幫我們把行李搬到房間。|We gave the bellhop a tip.|我們給了行李員小費。
housekeeping|n.|客房清潔服務|Housekeeping will clean your room while you are out.|您外出時，客房清潔人員會打掃您的房間。|Please call housekeeping if you need more towels.|如果需要更多毛巾，請打電話給客房服務。
amenities|n.|設施，便利設備|The hotel offers amenities like a pool and a gym.|這間旅館提供游泳池和健身房等設施。|Basic amenities such as soap and shampoo are free.|肥皂和洗髮精等基本備品是免費的。
bathtub|n.|浴缸|She relaxed in a hot bathtub after work.|她下班後在熱水浴缸裡放鬆。|The room has a shower and a bathtub.|這個房間有淋浴間和浴缸。
toothbrush|n.|牙刷|I forgot to pack my toothbrush.|我忘了帶牙刷。|You should change your toothbrush every three months.|你應該每三個月換一次牙刷。
hairdryer|n.|吹風機|There is a hairdryer in the bathroom.|浴室裡有一支吹風機。|Could I borrow a hairdryer from the front desk?|我可以向櫃檯借一支吹風機嗎？
scooter|n.|機車，小型摩托車|Many people in Taiwan ride a scooter to work.|台灣有很多人騎機車上班。|He parked his scooter next to the shop.|他把機車停在商店旁邊。
tram|n.|電車，有軌電車|We took the tram to the old town.|我們搭有軌電車到老城區。|The tram runs every ten minutes.|有軌電車每十分鐘一班。
ambulance|n.|救護車|Someone called an ambulance right away.|有人立刻叫了救護車。|The ambulance arrived in five minutes.|救護車五分鐘就到了。
tractor|n.|曳引機，拖拉機|The farmer drove his tractor across the field.|農夫開著曳引機穿過田野。|The tractor is used to plow the land.|曳引機是用來犁田的。
parking|n.|停車|There is free parking behind the building.|大樓後面有免費停車位。|Parking is not allowed on this street.|這條街禁止停車。
foggy|adj.|有霧的|It was so foggy that we could not see the road.|霧太濃了，我們看不見路。|Flights were canceled because of the foggy weather.|因為起霧的天氣，航班被取消了。
stormy|adj.|暴風雨的|The sea was too stormy for the boat to leave.|海面風浪太大，船無法出海。|We stayed at home on that stormy night.|那個暴風雨的夜晚我們待在家裡。
thunder|n.|雷，雷聲|The loud thunder woke me up.|響亮的雷聲把我吵醒了。|We heard thunder and then it began to rain.|我們聽到雷聲，然後就開始下雨了。
lightning|n.|閃電|A flash of lightning lit up the sky.|一道閃電照亮了天空。|The old tree was hit by lightning.|那棵老樹被閃電擊中了。
mist|n.|薄霧|Morning mist covered the lake.|晨間的薄霧籠罩著湖面。|The mountains disappeared in the mist.|山消失在薄霧之中。
breeze|n.|微風|A cool breeze came through the window.|一陣涼爽的微風從窗戶吹進來。|It was nice to sit by the sea in the evening breeze.|在傍晚的微風中坐在海邊真舒服。
typhoon|n.|颱風|The typhoon is expected to hit Taiwan tomorrow.|颱風預計明天侵襲台灣。|Schools were closed because of the typhoon.|因為颱風，學校停課了。
tornado|n.|龍捲風|The tornado destroyed several houses.|龍捲風摧毀了好幾間房屋。|People hid in the basement during the tornado.|龍捲風來襲時，人們躲在地下室。
rainbow|n.|彩虹|A beautiful rainbow appeared after the rain.|雨後出現了一道美麗的彩虹。|The children pointed at the rainbow in the sky.|孩子們指著天空中的彩虹。
frost|n.|霜|There was frost on the windows this morning.|今天早上窗戶上結了霜。|The frost killed some of the flowers in the garden.|霜凍害死了花園裡的一些花。
freezing|adj.|極冷的，冰凍的|It's freezing outside, so wear a warm coat.|外面冷得要命，所以要穿暖和的外套。|The water in the lake is freezing.|湖裡的水冰冷刺骨。
sunshine|n.|陽光|We enjoyed the warm sunshine at the beach.|我們在海灘享受溫暖的陽光。|The room is full of sunshine in the morning.|早上房間裡灑滿了陽光。
